from pathlib import Path
from zipfile import ZipFile, ZIP_DEFLATED
from shutil import copyfile

xlsx = Path('/home/user/OrderId_Month_Chart.xlsx')
backup = Path('/home/user/OrderId_Month_Chart.xlsx.bak')
copyfile(xlsx, backup)

with ZipFile(xlsx, 'r') as zin:
    files = {name: zin.read(name) for name in zin.namelist()}

sheet_name = 'xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'
xml = files[sheet_name].decode('utf-8')
# Remove any existing sparkline extension so repeated runs are deterministic.
marker = '<extLst><ext uri=\"{05C60535-1F16-4fd2-B633-F4F36F0B64E0}\"'
if marker in xml:
    start = xml.index(marker)
    end = xml.index('</extLst>', start) + len('</extLst>')
    xml = xml[:start] + xml[end:]

sparklines = []
for row in range(2, 24):
    sparklines.append(
        f'<x14:sparkline><xm:f>Sheet1"'!C{row}:E{row}</xm:f><xm:sqref>F{row}</xm:sqref></x14:sparkline>'"'
    )
ext = (
    '<extLst><ext uri=\"{05C60535-1F16-4fd2-B633-F4F36F0B64E0}\" '
    'xmlns:x14=\"http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/spreadsheetml/2009/9/main\">'
    '<x14:sparklineGroups xmlns:xm=\"http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/excel/2006/main\">'
    '<x14:sparklineGroup type=\"line\" displayEmptyCellsAs=\"gap\" markers=\"1\">'
    '<x14:colorSeries rgb=\"FF1F77B4\"/>'
    '<x14:colorNegative rgb=\"FFD62728\"/>'
    '<x14:colorAxis rgb=\"FF000000\"/>'
    '<x14:colorMarkers rgb=\"FF1F77B4\"/>'
    '<x14:colorFirst rgb=\"FF1F77B4\"/>'
    '<x14:colorLast rgb=\"FF1F77B4\"/>'
    '<x14:colorHigh rgb=\"FF2CA02C\"/>'
    '<x14:colorLow rgb=\"FFD62728\"/>'
    '<x14:sparklines>' + ''.join(sparklines) + '</x14:sparklines>'
    '</x14:sparklineGroup></x14:sparklineGroups></ext></extLst>'
)
xml = xml.replace('</worksheet>', ext + '</worksheet>')
files[sheet_name] = xml.encode('utf-8')

with ZipFile(xlsx, 'w', ZIP_DEFLATED) as zout:
    for name, data in files.items():
        zout.writestr(name, data)

print('Added 22 line sparklines in F2:F23 from C:E. Backup:', backup)
